automatically select taste, promote a prototype, accept risk, repair source from review, or release
remote Git, merge, deploy, provider mutation, or external write

gates: Routing must not smuggle design, review, source mutation, browser capture, or release judgment into the intake artifact.
authority-and-write-boundary
No existing route, content obligation, analytics event, SEO contract, user task, or behavior may be silently removed because it appears visually obsolete.
authority-and-write-boundary
Observed external values are evidence, not project authority: no project token, copied asset, or design decision may be written or approved by this capability.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: authorized external captures or files supplied

gates: The design direction cannot pass unless each major visual or spatial choice traces to product purpose, audience, content, brand authority, or an explicitly human-owned taste decision.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: new design, approved redesign, or selected visual work

gates: At least two variants must differ structurally on declared axes; palette-only or typography-only alternatives do not count as divergence.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: material uncertainty merits divergent working variants

gates: Every prominent visual device must serve hierarchy, task, content, state, or evidenced brand identity; unsupported decoration and generic template motifs must be removed.
authority-and-write-boundary
Do not create a parallel design system, token alias maze, or component abstraction when the existing project foundation can express the required states.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: tokens or reusable components are required

gates: No placeholder, invented claim, unverifiable metric, fake social proof, or unlicensed asset may enter a candidate presented as realistic or release-ready.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: interface contains product copy, records, imagery, icons, or claims

gates: Desktop and mobile endpoints are insufficient: the layout must survive intermediate widths, 200% zoom, long or localized content, overflow, and touch-target constraints without losing task order.
authority-and-write-boundary
The happy path cannot pass alone: every applicable loading, empty, validation, error, permission, disabled, interruption, success, and recovery state must exist and be reachable for verification.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: controls, navigation, forms, async data, permission, or recovery exist

gates: A generic WCAG checklist cannot pass: every criterion must name a user task, state, expected observable behavior, and current evidence or explicit untested risk.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: interactive user-facing surface is in scope

gates: Motion without a named communication purpose, deterministic end state, interruption behavior, and information-equivalent reduced-motion path must be removed or blocked.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: motion communicates hierarchy, navigation, feedback, progress, or state

gates: Never present generated content, confidence, personalization, or autonomous action as certain, authoritative, or irreversible when the system cannot prove it.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: probabilistic or agentic behavior is user-visible

gates: A preflight item passes only with current criterion-linked evidence; unchecked, not-applicable without rationale, and source-inspection-only items remain unresolved.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: implementation is ready for cross-domain preflight

gates: No capture is review evidence unless its source revision, runtime, route, state, viewport, zoom or scale, input mode, timestamp, tool, and hash are recorded and current.
authority-and-write-boundary
Static source review, DOM assertions, or a single ideal screenshot cannot substitute for current rendered evidence across the declared routes, states, viewports, input modes, and motion behavior.
authority-and-write-boundary
No release criterion may pass from source inspection, prior screenshots, or reviewer assertion when current rendered or interaction evidence is required.
authority-and-write-boundary
steps.when: specialist findings and current evidence are available
